Two firms set $3bn fundraising goal, sources say

Two payments infrastructure firms have set a goal of raising up to an additional $3 billion through a private token sale, according to people familiar with the matter. The round would value the combined entity at roughly $12 billion and would be one of the largest stablecoin-related raises of the year.

Both companies declined to comment on the size of the round, but confirmed that the proceeds would fund international expansion and licensing work in Europe and Asia.
